license_required.quote: it is unlawful for any person to practice dentistry in Indiana who is not licensed under this chapter

issuing_authority.quote: The state board of dentistry is established

name.quote: The state board of dentistry is established and consists of

type.quote: The state board of dentistry is established and consists of: (1) nine (9) practicing dentists licensed under IC 25-14 who must have been in practice in Indiana for not less than five (5) years; (2) one (1) practicing dental hygienist

moral_character_required.quote: An applicant under this article must submit proof satisfactory to the board that the applicant has not been convicted of a crime that has a direct bearing on the applicant's ability to practice competently

degree_required.value: Doctoral degree in dentistry from an accredited dental college
degree_required.quote: the applicant must submit to the board proof of graduation from a dental college recognized by the board. The board may recognize dental schools accredited by the Commission on Dental Accreditation of the American Dental Association

accrediting_body.value: Commission on Dental Accreditation of the American Dental Association
accrediting_body.quote: The board may recognize dental schools accredited by the Commission on Dental Accreditation of the American Dental Association

exams.name: National Board Dental Examination (Part I and Part II) and written jurisprudence examination
exams.quote: Every applicant must pass an examination administered by an entity approved by the board and may not take the examination more than three (3) times

interval_years.quote: a license issued by the board expires on a date specified by the agency under IC 25-1-5-4(l)

required.quote: A dentist must complete at least twenty (20) credit hours in continuing education courses each license period. At least half of the required minimum credit hours must be from live presentations or live workshops

hours_per_period.quote: A dentist must complete at least twenty (20) credit hours in continuing education courses each license period

period_years.quote: license period means the two (2) year period beginning on March 2, 1992, and every two (2) years thereafter

available.quote: The board may issue a license upon payment of a fee, set by the board under section 13 of this chapter, to an applicant who furnishes proof satisfactory to the board that the applicant is a dentist who: (1) is licensed in another state or a province of Canada that has licensing requirements substantially equal to those in effect in Indiana on the date of application

requirements.value: Licensed in another state with substantially equal requirements; practiced dentistry for at least 2 of the 3 years preceding application; passes law examination; completed required continuing education hours in previous 2 years
requirements.quote: an applicant who furnishes proof satisfactory to the board that the applicant is a dentist who: (1) is licensed in another state or a province of Canada that has licensing requirements substantially equal to those in effect in Indiana on the date of application; (2) has practiced dentistry for at least two (2) of the three (3) years preceding the date of application; (3) passes the law examination administered by the board or an entity approved by the board; (4) has completed the required hours of continuing education in the previous two (2) years

exists.quote: The state board of dentistry is established and consists of: (1) nine (9) practicing dentists licensed under IC 25-14 who must have been in practice in Indiana for not less than five (5) years; (2) one (1) practicing dental hygienist

credential_type.quote: A person desiring to begin the practice of dentistry in Indiana shall procure from the board a license to practice dentistry in Indiana

is_mandatory.quote: it is unlawful for any person to practice dentistry in Indiana who is not licensed under this chapter

title_protection.quote: A person is practicing dentistry within the meaning of this chapter if the person does any of the following: (1) Uses the word "dentist" or "dental surgeon", the letters "D.D.S." or "D.M.D.", or other letters or titles in connection with dentistry

scope_protection.quote: it is unlawful for any person to practice dentistry in Indiana who is not licensed under this chapter

disciplinary_grounds.description: Practicing dentistry without a valid license
disciplinary_grounds.quote: It is a Level 6 felony for a person to do any of the following: (1) Practice dentistry not being at the time a dentist duly licensed to practice as such in this state under this chapter

disciplinary_grounds.description: Employing an unlicensed person to practice dentistry
disciplinary_grounds.quote: It is a Level 6 felony for a person to do any of the following: (2) Employ, hire, or procure one who is not duly licensed as a dentist to practice dentistry

disciplinary_grounds.description: Fraudulently obtaining or using a dental license or diploma
disciplinary_grounds.quote: It is a Class B misdemeanor for a person to do any of the following: (1) Sell or barter, or offer to sell or barter, or, not being lawfully authorized so to do, issue or confer, or offer to issue or confer, any dental degree, license, or any diploma or document conferring, or purporting to confer, any dental degree or license

disciplinary_grounds.description: Using false or fraudulent dental credentials or diplomas
disciplinary_grounds.quote: It is a Class B misdemeanor for a person to do any of the following: (3) Use any diploma, certificate, or transcript which has been purchased, fraudulently issued, counterfeited, or materially altered, either as a license or color of license, to practice dentistry

disciplinary_grounds.description: Practicing dentistry under a false or misleading name
disciplinary_grounds.quote: It is a Class B misdemeanor for a person to do any of the following: (4) Practice dentistry under a false name, under a name intended to mislead the public, under the license of another person of the same name, or hold the person out to the public under such a name as a practitioner of dentistry

disciplinary_grounds.description: Assuming dental titles or degrees without proper authorization
disciplinary_grounds.quote: It is a Class B misdemeanor for a person to do any of the following: (5) Assume the title or degree of "Bachelor of Dental Surgery", append the letters "B.D.S.", "D.D.S.", "M.D.S.", or "D.M.D.", to the person's name, or make use of the same, or prefix to the person's name the title of "Doctor", or any abbreviation thereof, not having had duly conferred upon the person by diploma from some college, school, or board of examiners legally empowered to confer the same, the right to assume such a title

disciplinary_grounds.description: Failure to notify patients upon retirement or discontinuation of practice
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Upon retirement, discontinuation of practice, or moving from or leaving a community, a dentist shall: (1) notify all of the dentist's active patients in writing, or by publication once a week for three (3) consecutive weeks in a newspaper of general circulation in the community, that the dentist intends to discontinue the dentist's practice of dentistry in the community

disciplinary_grounds.description: Failure to transfer patient records upon retirement or discontinuation of practice
disciplinary_grounds.quote: The dentist who is retiring, discontinuing practice, or moving from or leaving a community shall make reasonable arrangements with the dentist's active patients for the transfer of the dentist's records, or copies of the records, to the succeeding dentist or, at the written request of the patient, to the patient, in compliance with IC 16-39

disciplinary_grounds.description: Failure to mark dentures with patient's name as required
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Each denture and each partial denture covered by section 2 or 3 of this chapter shall be marked with the patient's name

disciplinary_grounds.description: Failure to display license in dental office
disciplinary_grounds.quote: A dentist shall not fail to post, and keep conspicuously displayed, the dentist's name and license in the dental office wherein the dentist practices, in plain sight of the dentist's patients

definition_quote.value: A person is practicing dentistry within the meaning of this chapter if the person does any of the following: (1) Uses the word "dentist" or "dental surgeon", the letters "D.D.S." or "D.M.D.", or other letters or titles in connection with dentistry. (2) Directs and controls the treatment of patients within a place where dental services are performed. (3) Advertises or permits to be advertised by sign, card, circular, handbill, newspaper, radio, or otherwise that the person can or will attempt to perform dental operations of any kind. (4) Offers to evaluate, diagnose, prevent, or treat: (A) diseases, disorders, and conditions of the oral cavity and maxillofacial area; (B) diseases, disorders, and conditions of the associated and adjacent structures of the oral cavity and maxillofacial area if: (i) the dentist is providing emergency care; or (ii) the dentist has completed postgraduate training and certification in oral and maxillofacial surgery from a program certified by the Commission on Dental Accreditation; and (C) the effects of such diseases, disorders, and conditions on the human body; using nonsurgical, surgical, or related procedures. (5) Extracts human teeth or corrects malpositions of the teeth or jaws. (6) Except as provided in IC 25-13-1-10.5 and IC 25-13-1-10.6, administers dental anesthetics. (7) Uses x-ray images for dental diagnostic purposes. (8) Makes: (A) oral images for the fabrication of a final restoration, impression, or cast; (B) impressions; or (C) casts of any oral tissues or structures; for the purpose of diagnosis or treatment thereof or for the construction, repair, reproduction, or duplication of any prosthetic device to alleviate or cure any oral lesion or replace any lost oral structures, tissue, or teeth. (9) Advertises to the public by any method, except trade and professional publications, to furnish, supply, construct, reproduce, repair, or adjust any prosthetic denture, bridge, appliance, or other structure to be worn in the human mouth. (10) Is the employer of a dentist who is hired to provide dental services. (11) Directs or controls the use of dental equipment or dental material while the equipment or material is being used to provide dental services. (12) Directs, controls, or interferes with a dentist's clinical judgment. (13) Exercises direction or control over a dentist through a written contract concerning the following areas of dental practice

drug_authority.value: Dentists may prescribe drugs necessary in the practice of dentistry; licensed pharmacists may fill prescriptions of licensed dentists
drug_authority.quote: Licensed pharmacists of this state may fill prescriptions of licensed dentists of this state for any drug necessary in the practice of dentistry

value: moderate sedation using parenteral route of administration
sedation_anesthesia_permit_types.quote: A dentist must have a permit to administer: (1) general anesthesia/deep sedation; or (2) moderate sedation using a parenteral route of administration; to a patient

pediatric_sedation_endorsement_required.quote: The board shall establish the requirements for a program of education and training for pediatric anesthesiology

dental_hygienist_supervision_levels.quote: A licensed dental hygienist may practice dental hygiene in Indiana in the following: (1) A dental office, clinical setting, or health facility where the dental hygienist is practicing under the direct supervision or prescriptive supervision of a licensed dentist

collaborative_agreement_available.quote: Settings, other than a private dental practice, allowed under an access practice agreement that complies with the requirements under IC 25-13-3

advanced_practice_permit_available.quote: A dental hygienist who meets the following requirements may provide preventive dental hygiene services directly to a patient without a prior examination, presence, or authorization of the access practice dentist

value: patients in fixed charitable dental care clinics
advanced_practice_eligible_patient_popul.quote: A: (A) fixed charitable dental care clinic; (B) public health setting; (C) correctional institution; or (D) location other than one described in clauses (A) through (C); that has been approved by the board

dental_office_ownership_restrictions.quote: "Proprietor dentist" means a licensed dentist who is the owner and operator of the dental office in which the licensed dentist practices the profession of dentistry

dental_laboratory_work_authorization_req.quote: A written work authorization shall include the following: (1) The name and address of the dental laboratory to which it is directed. (2) The case identification. (3) A specification of the materials to be used. (4) A description of the work to be done and, if necessary, diagrams thereof. (5) The date of issuance of the authorization. (6) The signature and address of the licensed dentist or other dental practitioner by whom the work authorization is issued

denture_patient_identification_marking_r.quote: Each denture and each partial denture covered by section 2 or 3 of this chapter shall be marked with the patient's name

hygienist_local_anesthesia_certification.quote: a licensed dental hygienist may administer local dental anesthetics under the direct supervision of a licensed dentist under IC 25-14 if the dental hygienist has: (1) completed board approved educational requirements, including cardiopulmonary resuscitation and emergency care training; and (2) received a board issued dental hygiene anesthetic permit

hygienist_nitrous_oxide_certification_re.quote: A dental hygienist or dental assistant (as defined in IC 25-14-1-1.5(4)) may administer nitrous oxide under the direct supervision of a licensed dentist if the dental hygienist or dental assistant has: (1) been employed in a dental practice for at least one (1) year or has graduated from a program accredited by the Commission on Dental Accreditation of the American Dental Association; (2) satisfactorily completed a three (3) hour didactic nitrous oxide administration course

cpr_certification_required_for_sedation.quote: Before permitting a dental hygienist or dental assistant to administer nitrous oxide, the supervising dentist shall: (1) verify that the dental hygienist or dental assistant has completed the requirements of subsection (a); (2) determine the maximum percent-dosage of nitrous oxide to be administered to the patient

dental_hygienist_alternative_practice_li.quote: A dental hygienist who meets the following requirements may provide preventive dental hygiene services directly to a patient without a prior examination, presence, or authorization of the access practice dentist
